mapper.insert: INSERT INTO follows (follower_id, followee_id) VALUES (#{followerId}, #{followeeId}) ON CONFLICT (follower_id, followee_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{followerId} AND followee_id = #{followeeId}
mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM follows WHERE followee_id = #{userId}) AS followers_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{userId}) AS following_count, EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM follows WHERE follower_id = #{viewer} AND followee_id = #{userId}) AS is_following
